newsitem.title: USA: U.S. cotton weekly export sales highlights--USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. cotton weekly export sales highlights--USDA.

text.p: USDA cotton export sales highlights in latest reporting week:

Net Upland sales of 94,800 running bales (RB) advanced 10 percent above the previous week, but were off one-third from the 4-week average. Major increases for Russia (35,300 RB), Mexico (29,400 RB), China (8,300 RB), and Indonesia (6,700 RB) were partially offset by reductions of 10,500 RB for unknown destinations. Sales of 32,600 RB for delivery during the 1997/98 marketing year were primarily for Japan (23,500 RB).

Exports of 101,600 RB were 44 percent less than the previous week and one-half below the 4-week average. Asian destinations accounted for 64 percent of the week's shipments; Western Hemisphere, 29 percent; and West European, 7 percent.
